faq_heading: Homes near Bonaccord Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Bonaccord Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Bonaccord Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Bonaccord Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Bonaccord Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 100 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,100,000, townhomes $662,500, condos $490,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Bonaccord Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Bonaccord Elementary the median was 28 days on the market, closing at 96.5% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 100 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Bonaccord Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Mountainview Montessori (0.5 km east), Johnston Heights Secondary (0.8 km east) and Berkshire Park Elementary (1.1 km south-east).

Bonaccord Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 14986 98 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names Bonaccord Elementary. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 1 km of the school.
How the Bonaccord Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Bonaccord Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Bonaccord Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 100 homes sold within 1 km of Bonaccord Elementary: 27 houses, 14 townhomes and 59 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $490,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Bonaccord Elementary

36 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Bonaccord Elementary in a straight line (22 elementary, 13 secondary, 1 other; 5 independent). The closest is Mountainview Montessori, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is Our Lady of Good Counsel, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Johnston Heights Secondary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Our Lady of Good Counsel (2.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is North Surrey Secondary (2.0 km). Other elementary schools close by: Mountainview Montessori (0.5 km east), Berkshire Park Elementary (1.1 km south-east), William F. Davidson Elementary (1.2 km east), Hjorth Road Elementary (1.3 km north), Lena Shaw Elementary (1.6 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Mountainview Montessori, 0.5 km east of Bonaccord Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Bonaccord Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Bonaccord Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Bonaccord Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median condo within 1 km of Bonaccord Elementary was $490,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Mountainview Montessori, the nearest other elementary school, 0.5 km east of Bonaccord Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
